comment: Shot list for the NEON VICE capture flow. Each shot loads the app from serve.ts with a deterministic ?shot= mode (bundled samples only, fixed state), waits for window.__shotReady, and saves a JPEG at the given viewport. Constraints per file: JPEG, <= 262144 bytes, long side <= 1280, short side >= 480.

shots.note: The exported NEON SHORES landscape cover itself: the app canvas at 1920x1080, shown full-viewport and captured at 1280x720.
